name: Gästehaus Lärchenheim
beschreibung: Gästehaus Lärchenheim in Gerlos is a charming inn that preserves its authentic traditional character. The guesthouse enjoys a quiet and idyllic location on the outskirts of Gerlos. The surrounding area offers direct access to the premier hiking trails and ski slopes of the Zillertal Alps. Guests can expect straightforward, functional room furnishings designed for restful stays. The house features a restaurant serving delicious regional cuisine. The welcoming ambiance is steeped in genuine Tyrolean warmth and honest comfort. Gerlos is the ideal starting point for memorable outdoor adventures in alpine nature.
